01

How far in advance should I book a shoot?
It’s best to book at least 2–4 weeks in advance to secure your preferred date, especially for events and weddings.

02

How long does it take to receive the final photos?
Final edited images are typically delivered within 7–14 days, depending on the size and type of the project.

03

Do you travel for shoots?
Yes, I’m available for travel. Travel costs and details can be discussed based on location and project scope.

04

How many photos will I receive?
The number of delivered images depends on the shoot type, but you’ll always receive a carefully curated and edited selection.

05

Can I request edits or revisions?
Yes, small revisions are included to make sure the final images meet your expectations.

06

Do you offer commercial usage rights?
Yes, commercial usage can be included for brand and business projects. Details are shared before the shoot.
